exclusion_detail: The featured compounds are three copper(II) coordination complexes (C1-C3) of quinoline Schiff-base ligands L1/L2; metal complexes are out of scope.

lead.label: C1-C3 (copper(II) complexes)
lead.why: Abstract: three copper(II) complexes [Cu(L1)(NO3)2] (C1), [Cu(L2)Cl2] (C2), [Cu(L2)SO4]2.H2O (C3) were designed and synthesized; no single best compound named.

notes: The free ligands L1/L2 (imines from quinoline-8-carbaldehyde and methyl/ethyl 4-aminobenzoate) are one-step but are not the featured compounds.
